metadata.title: Frontier Wheelchair Rugby Tactical Intelligence Database

legacy_2004.name: 2004 Legacy Strict Cap
legacy_2004.description: Historical strict 8.0 point ceiling without female player allowances.

current_2024.name: 2024 Current Official Cap
current_2024.description: Base 8.0 cap with +0.5 point bonus per female athlete on court (max 8.5 with 1 female, 9.0 with 2).

hypothetical_7_5.name: Hypothetical Parity / Defensive Cap (7.5)
hypothetical_7_5.description: Strict 7.5 point cap to prohibit dual 3.5 super-pairings and force deeper low-pointer utilization.

hypothetical_9_0.name: Hypothetical Power Rugby Cap (9.0)
hypothetical_9_0.description: Expansive 9.0 point cap permitting ultra-athletic dual 3.5 + 1.0 + 1.0 or 3.0 + 3.0 + 2.0 + 1.0 lineups.

archetypes.name: Apex Ball Carrier & Slasher
archetypes.core_attributes: Elite scoring velocity, end-to-end acceleration, high possession usage, targeted defensive gravity.

archetypes.name: Corner Screener & Trap Specialist
archetypes.core_attributes: Mastery of chair positioning, blocking high-pointer slashes, inbounding reliability, creating clear lanes.

archetypes.name: Defensive Disrupter & Ball Denier
archetypes.core_attributes: Disruptive trap defense, intercepting pass angles, stripping inbound passes, neutralising opposing mid-pointers.

archetypes.name: Mid-Point Floor General & Connector
archetypes.core_attributes: High basketball/rugby IQ, tempo control, precise full-court cross-court passes, secondary scoring when high pointers are sealed.

archetypes.name: Two-Way Hybrid Wing
archetypes.core_attributes: Versatile forward play, switchability on defense, transition counter-attacks, line-crossing resilience.
